I set the number format on the Operating Hours and Idle Hours columns in the FleetTable to `#,0.0`, so values now show a thousands separator and one decimal place (e.g. 1,234.5).

The change is in the detail cells only; the column headers are unchanged. The report validates. The warnings it raised (unused data sources, date parameters typed as String, and a `Utilization` field the query may not return) were already there and I left them alone.
